# NLS (oN-Line System)

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_reference.py from the pack's pack.json — do not edit. -->

**Imitates:** oN-Line System, SRI Augmentation Research Center — as shown at the Fall Joint Computer Conference, 9 December 1968 NLS on the SDS 940, 1968 · **Pack id:** `nls` · **Selected by:** `pack="nls"`, `import NLS`, `import OnLineSystem`, `import ARC` · **Default device:** desktop (none chrome)

30 own elements, plus 134 core elements in this pack's style.
Each entry shows the element rendered with sample arguments (and, for the pack's own

defaults and variants.
